methodology.gpuScope: system-wide estimated GPU power and hardware active residency
methodology.windowServerCpuUnits: 100% equals one CPU core; initial top sample discarded
methodology.energyUnits: Joules integrated from estimated GPU milliwatts and elapsed time; per-60-second values are normalized from average power
methodology.limitations: Synthetic image scene on one machine. Other applications remain running. No per-app energy attribution or battery-life claim.

measurementContext.display: One main display reporting 1920 x 1080 at 100 Hz
measurementContext.window: 680 x 720 content pixels; opaque Electron fixture window kept always on top
measurementContext.focus: Not held fixed throughout sampling; see per-phase windowCheckBeforeSampling
